newsitem.title: USA: Midas narrows advertising bidders to two agencies.
newsitem.headline: Midas narrows advertising bidders to two agencies.

text.p: Midas International Corp, the world's largest franchised automotive service operation, said Monday it named two Chicago agencies as finalists in its search for a new advertising agency for its $25 million national account.
DDB Needham and Foote, Cone & Belding will make creative presentations to Midas in mid-August.
Midas said it expects to name a new agency by the end of August.
Earlier this month, Midas named four agencies to make presentations including Euro RSCG Tatham and Cramer-Krasselt.
The new agency, which succeeds J. Walter Thompson USA, will be responsible for creative, national media planning and buying.
Foote, Cone & Belding is a subsidiary of True North Communications Inc.
In late June, Whitman Corp announced a plan to spin off Midas from its parent as a publicly traded independent company.
Midas, which operates more than 2,500 stores in 17 countries, reported systemwide sales and revenues of more than $1.3 billion in 1996.
